*   **y:** Medium value ($71), highest priority (1). This is a good option. Even if others want y, I have a good chance of being accepted.

My strategy is to rank w first, hoping that my priority 1 is enough to get me in. If I get rejected from w, I want a good backup. Since x is better than z, I will rank x before z.
